title: Lights, Camera, Action!
overview: Leo's day off turns hectic when he is tasked to escort the live head of the U.S. Presidential Envoy while avoiding waves of thugs after him.

title: A Phantom Hospital Ward Rises
overview: Leo takes a seriously injured Zapp to a mysterious hospital that appeared out of thin air. Klaus and Stephen then tell Leo a story of what happened there during the cataclysm that created Hellsalem's Lot three years ago.

title: Day In Day Out
overview: Refusing to use his special powers at his own benefit, Leo decides to take matters with his own hands to get back the money some thugs stole from him, while Zapp is forced to look for a friend's cat with his own nether parts in the line and Steven welcomes some guests with second intentions for a party at his house.

title: Werewolf Mission: Chainpossible
overview: Chain and her fellow werewolves are tasked to a special mission, unaware that an old enemy of theirs is waiting for an ambush.

title: One Butler's Blitzkrieg
overview: After Gilbert is seriously wounded, Philip Lenore, another butler is sent by the Reinherz family to assist him while he recuperates. When knowing that Philip fell in a trap and his brain is under some criminals' custody, Gilbert assembles a team to rescue him personally.

title: Get the Lock Out!!
overview: The members of Libra are locked out of their headquarters by bizarre insectoid monsters and must find a way back inside before a catastrophic event devastates the city.

title: Branchial Blues
overview: The special headphones that allows Zed to breathe out of water is stolen by a sociopathic CEO of an arms dealing company forcing Leo, Zapp and Chain to steal it back. Meanwhile, Zed recounts the day he first met Raju Jugei Shizuyoshi.

title: Desperate Fight in the Macro Zone, Part 1
overview: Chaos ensues when Riel, one of Leonardo's friends is transformed into a giant, vicious monster by a microscopic terrorist.

title: Desperate Fight in the Macro Zone, Part 2
overview: Leo and his friends join forces in a combined effort to bring Riel back to normal before he destroys the city.

title: Bratatat Mom
overview: K.K.’s promise to her son that she’ll attend parent’s day at school get in the way when she has to go on a critical mission for Steven to take down a crime syndicate named Brigade Argento and their Blood Breed bodyguard. In order for her to handle both tasks, she gets Libra’s arms dealer Patrick to hook her up with some remote firepower.

title: Spectral Eyes, Phantom Vision, Part 1
overview: Leonardo is shocked when his sister Michella reveals she’s getting married and that she’ll be coming to Hellsalem’s Lot alongside her fiancee. Upon hearing this, Libra assembles in full force to protect her during her visit on the belief that her eyes are linked to Leo’s. However, Leo is taken for a loop when he discovers the groom has a dangerous secret of his own; one directly connected to the All-Seeing Eyes of the Gods.

title: Spectral Eyes, Phantom Vision, Part 2
overview: With his sister being held hostage, and no backup from Libra, Leo has no choice but to follow Dr. Gamimozu’s orders. Leo uses his intelligence and perseverance to distract Dr. Gamimozu until Libra arrives to save the day.
